verses.text: A Psalm of David. O YHWH, who may sojourn in Your tent? Who may dwell in the mountain of Your Holiness?

segments.text: A Psalm of David. O YHWH, who may sojourn in Your tent? Who may dwell in the mountain of Your Holiness?

verses.text: The one walking blamelessly, and doing righteousness, and speaking truth in his heart.

segments.text: The one walking blamelessly, and doing righteousness, and speaking truth in his heart.

verses.text: He does not have slander upon his tongue, and he has not done evil to his neighbor, and a reproach he has not taken up against his neighbor.

segments.text: He does not have slander upon his tongue, and he has not done evil to his neighbor, and a reproach he has not taken up against his neighbor.

verses.text: A rejected one is despised in his eyes, and those fearful of YHWH he honors—one [who] swears to endure evil, and not changing.

segments.text: A rejected one is despised in his eyes, and those fearful of YHWH he honors—one [who] swears to endure evil, and not changing.

verses.text: His silver he has not given in usury, and he does not take a bribe against the innocent. The one doing these [things] is not shaken forever.

segments.text: His silver he has not given in usury, and he does not take a bribe against the innocent. The one doing these [things] is not shaken forever.
